entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hi, thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... I'm a bit lost. I ordered a helmet a while ago and... it's just not right. I need to send it back, I think. Your website is so confusing.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please tell me your order number? And just so I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I... I think I have the number here... it's VF88602. It's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked different online. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. Thank you for that order number. Let me just pull up the details.
Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, placed 57 days ago. Since it's a preference regarding the color, let me just check our return eligibility for you.

Good news. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. Since the box is unopened, we can absolutely process that for you. We are very strict about returns for safety equipment, but an unused helmet is no problem.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you, Sarah. You've been a huge help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
